name: Haran (Abraham's brother, Lot's father)
title: Lot's father from Ur
summary: Haran was the son of Terah and the brother of Abraham and Nahor. He is best known as the father of Lot and died in his homeland, Ur of the Chaldees, before the family emigrated to Canaan. His early death in Ur marks a turning point in the family's history.

keyEvents.title: Haran's Birth and Family
keyEvents.description: Haran was born as the son of Terah in Ur of the Chaldees. He was the brother of Abram (Abraham) and Nahor.

keyEvents.title: Father of Lot, Milka, and Jiska
keyEvents.description: Haran became the father of three children: Lot, who later accompanied Abraham; Milka, who married Nahor; and Jiska.

keyEvents.title: Harans Death in Ur
keyEvents.description: Haran died in his homeland, in Ur of the Chaldees, while his father Terah was still alive. He was the first of Terah's sons to die.
